tools.name: get_phone_capabilities
tools.description: Discover supported countries, per-operation review coverage, evidence, dataset versions and request limits before choosing a phone workflow.

tools.name: analyze_phone_number
tools.description: Analyze a number using versioned numbering metadata. National numbers need numberCountryCode; exit prefixes need originCountryCode. Reports uncertainty and rule evidence, never live subscriber status.

tools.name: get_dialing_instructions
tools.description: Prepare origin-specific dialing guidance for reviewed countries. Provide origin and destination separately; no phone number returns safe placeholder patterns. Network-dependent results remain conditional.

tools.name: normalize_phone_numbers
tools.description: Normalize up to 100 records with unique IDs. Invalid records produce individual errors. Optionally identify canonical duplicate candidates; no contacts are changed or stored.

tools.name: compare_phone_numbers
tools.description: Compare two numbers after analysis. Missing context produces indeterminate. Extensions must match unless extensionPolicy is explicitly ignore; equality does not establish ownership.

tools.name: resolve_phone_region
tools.description: Resolve a phone number to metadata-backed country candidates or non-geographic numbering. Results are numbering assignments, not current location or carrier.

tools.name: get_phone_input_rules
tools.description: Get reviewed display placeholders and trunk-prefix guidance. Examples are not validation masks. English fallback and unsupported editorial coverage are explicit.

tools.name: diagnose_dialing_problem
tools.description: Explain formatting issues and propose reviewed prefix repairs for confirmation. Uses the same analyzer. Cannot determine why a network rejected a call.

tools.name: find_calling_windows
tools.description: Find overlapping working hours using explicit IANA time zones and dates. Handles overnight shifts and DST; never infers location from phone numbers or contacts participants.

tools.name: lookup_country_calling_code
tools.description: Look up international country calling codes by free text, ISO code, dial code, or region. Optionally return reviewed, source-linked dialing examples. This tool does not verify live subscriber numbers.

tools.name: format_international_phone_number
tools.description: Normalize a phone number into a plausible international format using reviewed country-specific rules. Processing is ephemeral. This tool does not query carriers, HLR/HSS, MNP databases, or live subscribers.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_country_calling_code" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up international country calling codes by free text, ISO code, dial code, or region." → after: "Look up international country calling codes by free text, ISO code, dial code, or region. Optionally return reviewed, source-linked dialing examples. This tool does not verify live subscriber numbers."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
